description: Rubble-grade rock studded with raw gold. It was a Mosscairn's shoulder until you argued about ownership.
lore: The first thing a new cracker is taught about ore is how to be disappointed properly. Teeth are no use on rock. You drag a fleck across a pale stone and read the line it leaves — true gold draws yellow, the pretty fraud draws black — and then you heft the lump, because a fist of real ore weighs like a bigger stone than it looks.

The second thing is that [[characters/2f7f1de9|Halvard]] pays under weight for it, always, and will not be moved. [[lore/the_gold_agreement|A coin is the one thing everyone remembers the same]]; a rock with gold in it is a rock with an argument in it, and he does not trade in arguments. Melt it and come back, he says. Half the sheds think he is squeezing them. The other half has noticed he pays exactly the same under-weight to the people he likes.
